main_text.head: Epistola Dedicatoria.
main_text.p: pistolæ Petri Mussardi, Viri longè reverendi & scriptis ac concionibus tonantibus, diu Illustris in Gallia nostra, nunc Pastoris Ecclesiæ Gallo-Londinensis, ad perinde reverendum virum Ludovicum Tronchinum, Pastorem & Professorem Genevensem: in quo fragmento, usque adeo ingenuè & candidè mentem & sententiam meam, in re, de qua nunc mihi lis est cum Celeberrimo Claudio Pastore Ecclesiæ Parisiensis, exponit & exscribit, ut nunquam sperare potuissem de viribus meis, aptioribus verbis & minus in sequiorem sensum, (ut

page.notes: The page is a single column. The heading is roman capitals and lowercase, set larger than the text. The faint marks at the foot (a letter and figure, possibly a signature such as "A 2") are too unclear to read, so I left them out. Show-through from the other side appears throughout and was not transcribed. The final "(ut" is cut off at the end of the page, as printed.
